observations.consequence: The service can suffer simultaneous performance degradation from N+1 queries and data compromise from a possible SQL injection, risking downtime and loss of data integrity.
Under load the pool can be exhausted as N+1 queries increase latency and a network call without timeout blocks workers indefinitely, causing request timeouts and loss of availability.

observations.mechanism: absence of health‑check monitoring of downstream calls
observations.consequence: The service may stay marked healthy while a hanging network call (no timeout) blocks workers, leading to silent outages despite passing readiness probes.
